raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Some raw_customers rows carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names, so silver_customers and gold_region_daily show invalid regions. raw_region_map covers all four codes one-to-one (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH), so these rows can be translated to the canonical names deterministically.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = trim(m.region_code)"}}
